newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-BELGIAN DE BILDE SIGNS FOR PSV EINDHOVEN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BELGIAN DE BILDE SIGNS FOR PSV EINDHOVEN.

text.p: Dutch first division leaders and former European champions PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday signed Belgian striker Gilles de Bilde from Anderlecht on a four-and-a-half-year contract, Dutch news agency ANP said.

De Bilde, 25, will team up with fellow Belgian international striker Luc Nilis. But the partnership will have to wait as de Bilde is suspended from all soccer until March 31 after he assaulted another player in a Belgian league game.
The Belgian soccer union imposed the ban earlier this month after de Bilde struck Aalst's Krist Porte, breaking his eye socket and nose, during a match in December.
De Bilde, who moved to Anderlecht from Aalst in 1995 after turning down a lucrative offer from Atletico Madrid, has fallen from grace in recent months.
He became a national celebrity when he was voted Belgian Player of the Year in 1994, but has since picked up a "bad boy" image.
He faces trial for allegedly hitting two male nurses in August 1995 when he was denied access to his father in hospital.
